items.title: Chartering and Field of Membership for Federal Credit Unions-Interpretive Ruling and Policy Statement 08-2
items.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is rescinding Interpretive Ruling and Policy Statement (IRPS) 08-2.

items.title: Chartering and Field of Membership for Federal Credit Unions-Interpretive Ruling and Policy Statement 06-1
items.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is rescinding Interpretive Ruling and Policy Statement (IRPS) 06-1.

items.title: Chartering and Field of Membership for Federal Credit Unions-Interpretive Ruling and Policy Statement 10-1
items.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is rescinding Interpretive Ruling and Policy Statement (IRPS) 10-1.

items.title: Termination of Excess Insurance Coverage
items.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is amending its regulations that establish the requirements for obtaining and maintaining federal share insurance with the National Credit Union Share Insurance Fund (Share Insurance Fund).
entities: National Credit Union Share Insurance Fund

items.title: Corporate Credit Unions
items.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is issuing this action to rescind its Interpretive Ruling and Policy Statement (IRPS) 11-02, which addresses chartering corporate credit unions, because it is redundant to the Federal Corporate Credit Union Chartering Manual.
entities: Federal Corporate Credit Union Chartering Manual

items.title: Third-Party Servicing of Indirect Vehicle Loans
items.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is issuing a final rule removing NCUA's unnecessarily prescriptive regulation regarding third-party servicing of indirect vehicle loans.

items.title: Requirements for Insurance
items.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is amending its regulations that establish the requirements for obtaining and maintaining federal share insurance with the National Credit Union Share Insurance Fund (Share Insurance Fund).
entities: National Credit Union Share Insurance Fund

items.title: Limits on Loans to Other Credit Unions
items.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is issuing this rule to remove the regulations related to approval and policies on making loans to other credit unions.

items.title: Purchase, Sale, and Pledge Of Eligible Obligations
items.summary: This final rule streamlines the NCUA Board (Board)'s regulations governing the purchase, sale, and pledge of eligible obligations.

items.title: Suretyship and Guaranty; Segregated Deposit and Collateral
items.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is amending its regulations to eliminate prescriptive segregated deposit and collateral requirements for suretyship and guaranty agreements.

items.title: Dependent Care and Board Member Expense Reimbursement
items.summary: The NCUA Board is amending its regulations concerning the reimbursement of reasonable expenses for federal credit union (FCU) officials.

items.title: Credit Union Service Contracts
items.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is revising its regulations governing the organization and operation of federal credit unions (FCUs) by eliminating a provision related to credit union service contracts.

items.title: Preemption-Federal Credit Union Non-Interest Charges and Fees

items.title: Prohibition on the Use of Reputation Risk
items.summary: On October 21, 2025, the Board issued its Notice of Proposed Rulemaking to codify the elimination of reputation risk from its supervisory framework. This change aligns with Executive Order 14331, "Guaranteeing Fair Banking for All Americans.

items.title: Community Development Revolving Loan Fund
items.summary: NCUA is issuing this Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) to announce the availability of loan funding for qualifying credit unions through the Community Development Revolving Loan Fund (CDRLF).

items.title: Financial Data Transparency Act Joint Data Standards
items.summary: The OCC, Board, FDIC, NCUA, CFPB, FHFA, CFTC, SEC, and Treasury are publishing a final joint rule to establish data standards to promote interoperability of financial regulatory data across these agencies.
